key_insight: A generalized nudged elastic band framework finds transition pathways by jointly optimizing atomic positions, lattice geometry, and magnetic configurations.
engineering_relevance: The method enables coupled magnetostructural barrier calculations relevant to designing magnetic materials and devices.
method: Integrates NEB with potential-based constrained density-functional theory.
Couples atomic forces, cell stresses, and magnetic spin torques.
Supports fixed or variable cells and collinear or non-collinear magnetism.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks examine bcc-to-hcp Fe, antiferromagnetic-to-ferromagnetic FeRh, and spin reversal in two-dimensional CrI3 with attention to spin-orbit coupling.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative accuracy or computational-cost results, limiting assessment of scalability.
paper_title: Combined magnetic and structural transition state in first-principles calculations
